objective: 让Strategy Agent真实路径执行admission探索规则并记录identity级RecordOnly与frontier证据

semantic_brief.summary: Agent已绑定accepted exploration context，但节点处理仍由旧dispatch policy和数字depth阈值决定。此增量仅在Strategy-bound路径应用规则，生成Agent-owned identity证据，并保持legacy路径逐项兼容。
core_points: Strategy节点先分类再进入任何authorization或dispatch
RecordOnly由accepted observation直接满足且零设备动作
depth边界使用admission boundary disposition而非数字猜测
legacy无Strategy context路径保持原行为

change_principles: 只在AcceptedExplorationContext非null的Strategy-bound路径使用admission semantics；legacy context为null时必须保留现有depth 0/1、classifier-null、authorization和dispatch行为
Strategy-bound候选在fresh grounding成立后必须先调用generic CategoryClassifier；classifier缺席或返回null均记录该approved identity为unresolved并跳过authorization和dispatch，不得猜测类别或规则
NavigableContainer使用admitted ContainerRule；其ExpandContainer继续通过现有fresh grounding、CandidateAuthorizationEvaluator、TypeLevelDispatchPolicy和Traversal路径，dispatch或authorization本身不写RecordOnly satisfaction
其他当前封闭类别使用admitted LeafRule；RecordOnly必须在Agent现有owner下记录scope、approved identity与fresh accepted observation sequence，随后零authorization、零dispatch、零state mutation

Strategy-bound depth boundary必须读取AcceptedExplorationContext.Semantics.BoundaryDisposition：FailClosed保持既有cutoff失败；RecordOnly逐identity验证approved inventory source observation并分类，unclassifiable记unresolved，classified节点记RecordOnly satisfaction，仅NavigableContainer同时记unknown frontier identity
把unknown frontier从detached per-scope count改为Agent-owned per-scope identity set，并保留现有UnknownFrontierBeyondDepth count projection供兼容测试读取；新增只读identity evidence观察面，不建立新owner
Strategy-bound重新计算pending时必须排除已RecordOnly satisfied或unresolved的identity，使处理后下一轮可通过既有root GoalEvidence或verified parent return终止；GoalEvidence、FSM和terminal authority不得改变
acceptance: 真实Strategy Fake World测试证明classified leaf收到RecordOnly observation sequence，CandidateAuthorizationEvaluator调用数为0、ActionHistory无对应Tap/SetSwitch且节点不会进入AuthorizedSiblingEvidence
真实Strategy测试证明classified container仍经authorization并由Traversal展开，只有verified subtree return后才存在completed evidence
真实Strategy测试证明unclassifiable节点在authorization前进入unresolved，authorization调用数为0、零dispatch且无推断规则

Strategy depth测试覆盖0、1、N exhaustive与N match-inspection：0根inventory record-only；1根展开且direct-child inventory record-only；N exhaustive cutoff fail closed；N inspect boundary record-only并写unknown frontier identity
测试证明RecordOnly不会产生state-changing side effect，legacy ExplorationDepthBoundaryTests和UnresolvedNodeFailClosedPathTests保持绿色
dotnet build src/UniClaw.Runtime.sln 0 error，且git diff仅包含scope.write文件
forbidden: 禁止从UI文字、页面路径、selector、坐标或场景标签推断规则；测试fixture文字不得进入production
禁止新增Evidence owner、状态系统、wire/schema、Phase 3 Memory或dynamic depth
禁止修改OpenSpec、文档、WorkItem或其他已有改动
escalation: 若generic TypeLevelElementCategory无法区分container与leaf而需要新分类协议，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_SPEC
若RecordOnly终止需要改变GoalEvidence、FSM或completion authority，停止并返回BLOCKED_FOR_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW
若legacy回归只能通过改变旧行为解决，保留失败证据并返回Leader
